verdict.rationale: ernd is a corporate charge card and rewards program for AI vendor spend. Its core product is an issued financial instrument with cash-back, points and partner perks, which is not software a user could self-host, so asking for self-hosting is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence suggests any self-hostable deployment.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
